```yaml
name: Publish Remote Config

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install uv
          uv sync --dev

      - name: Export remote config
        run: |
          python -m kiln.export_config > remote_config.json

      - name: Configure git
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

      - name: Commit and push config to gh-pages
        run: |
          git fetch origin gh-pages || true
          git checkout -B gh-pages
          git add remote_config.json
          git commit -m "Update remote config" || echo "No changes to commit"
          git push origin gh-pages --force
```
